description:
Exact producer evidence is authenticated and assembled into one attested, overwrite-forbidden candidate-root artifact.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workflow downloads validation and producer evidence only by exact artifact ID, verifies REST/run metadata, schemas, expiry, ZIP and subject digests, candidate/freeze identities, workflow provenance, and attestations, and never selects by name or latest success.
- [hard] REQ-02: The root records the authenticated handoff/event/validation parents and every native, source, SPDX, MCP, OCI, documentation, release-metadata, identity, digest, expiry, and protocol field without inference or substitution.
- [hard] REQ-03: The root manifest is attested and uploaded once with overwrite disabled and 90-day retention; its exact artifact ID, digest, expiry, attestation, run, and parent identities are exposed for escrow.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fixtures reject missing or substituted evidence, insufficient retention, failed upload or attestation, source change, public mutation, and assembly that rebuilds or modifies any candidate byte.

## Notes

Blast radius: candidate-root workflow YAML, manifest assembly, exact-evidence verification, and root fixtures only; escrow publication is outside scope.
title: Implement candidate-root assembly workflow
